t: You're looking at Richmond House, a government building on Whitehall in the City of Westminster. Its name comes from an older townhouse of the Duke of Richmond that once stood on this site. The present building was designed by the architect Sir William Whitfield. Caroline Fox, later Baroness Holland, was born here. She was the eldest of the Lennox sisters, daughter of the 2nd Duke of Richmond, and the sisters became notorious in Georgian times for their scandalous behaviour.
